description:
Goal: a tight audit trail of what pipeline runs did, built from GitHub webhooks. At the very least, each run must say whether it opened a PR, and what happened to that PR.

Read first: CLAUDE.md, docs/00-glossary.md, docs/10-design.md, docs/20-routes.md.

## Why

Today Agbredo knows a run only if a job asked for a telemetry token, and from webhooks it reads only `workflow_run`, re-fetching the run from the API. Everything else is dropped (internal/webapi/api.go, func webhook; internal/core/worker.go, func Webhook).

Evidence gathered on 2026-10-15:
- Railway logs: the App receives only `workflow_run` (plus `security_advisory`, ignored).
- xpmatteo/rpg-interpreter run 38696780798 (Agent instructions audit, 07:08 UTC, 17 s) was a skip: the gate step passed, every later step was `skipped`, because audit PR #13 was open. Agbredo got its three workflow_run webhooks and dropped them; the run never asked for a token, so Agbredo has no record of it.
- Audit PRs in rpg-interpreter: 13 so far, 1 merged, 11 closed without merging, 1 open. Agbredo sees none of this.

## Decisions made with Matt on 2026-10-15

1. Record everything, interpret separately. Every verified webhook delivery is archived raw in the telemetry store (OpenObserve), as an OTLP log record through the existing forwarder. Postgres keeps only the derived facts plus one small index row per delivery.
2. Trust HMAC-verified webhook payloads as coming from GitHub. New code reads facts from the signed payload; it does not need to re-fetch from the API. (Change to the trust model, approved.)
3. Record runs of every live deployment from webhooks, including disabled deployments. Recording grants nothing; a disabled deployment still gets no telemetry token. Webhooks never create deployments.
4. Jobs and steps come from one API call when a run completes, not from a `workflow_job` subscription (avoids a delivery for every CI job in every installed repo).
5. PRs: record every bot-authored PR in a repo with a deployment, whatever the agent did. Link it to a run with a confidence level: declared (valid `Agbredo-Run:` trailer), inferred (time window), or unlinked. Rule breaks are recorded as findings, not dropped. An agent that does not follow the rules must still leave a trace.
6. Human PRs stay only in the raw archive.

## Order

ag-o6z.1 archive deliveries → ag-o6z.2 runs without telemetry → ag-o6z.3 jobs and steps → ag-o6z.4 PR activity. ag-o6z.6 (pipeline trailer) can go in parallel. ag-o6z.5 (installation events, beadwork pushes) is deferred. Related, outside the epic: ag-4jk (no write token for Claude in the pipeline).

All children change the schema or what the server stores; that design talk is done (above). Anything not covered here: ask Matt. Migrations are append-only (next number is 007). Keep backwards compatibility of stored JSON and routes.
title: Audit trail of pipeline runs from GitHub webhooks
